SELECT
    ag.label AS age_group,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(*) AS value
FROM mamba_fact_attended_visit v
         JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
              ON v.patient_id = mdp.patient_id
         JOIN mamba_dim_age_category ac
              ON ac.code = 'MOH_105_OPD_DIAG'
         JOIN mamba_dim_age_group ag
              ON ag.age_category_id = ac.age_category_id
                  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, v.first_qualifying_encounter_datetime)
                     BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
WHERE v.first_qualifying_encounter_datetime >= :startDate
  AND v.first_qualifying_encounter_datetime <  :endDate
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ag.sort_order, ag.label, mdp.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, mdp.gender;

SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  mdp.gender AS gender,
  COUNT(*) AS value
FROM mamba_fact_attended_visit v
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp

JOIN mamba_dim_age_category ac

JOIN mamba_dim_age_group ag

 AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, v.first_qualifying_encounter_datetime)

         JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
              ON mdp.patient_id = a.patient_id
